# Lucy

## Overview

- **Age:** eight (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Farewell P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P6](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0006), [v3 ch.Change P36](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0036)</sub>
- **Status:** alive (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Change P33](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0033)</sub>
- **Family:** [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md) (sibling), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Lucy is a lovely child who possesses gentle, mild hazel eyes, a straight nose, and long, sleek curls that are kept perfectly neat. She presents an immaculate and genteel appearance in a crisp, starched white dress accented by a black sash. However, after tumbling topsy-turvy down the exterior cellar stairs, all the skin was stripped from her nose.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P32](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0032), [v3 ch.Change P33](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0033)_

## Personality

Lucy is an amiable, well-behaved, and proper individual known for her calm and quiet demeanor. Remarkably dependable, tidy, and hard-working, she approaches her small responsibilities with care, system, and a distinct lack of emotion. She is perceptive enough to learn tasks quickly without forgetting instructions, and she remains modest and decorous, if extremely rigid, in formal company.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P87](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0087), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), +5 more_

## History

As a newly orphaned twin, Lucy was brought alongside her brother [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) by [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) to live at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). Early in her time there, she was enticed outside by [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md), jumping into a pigpen and getting drenched under a water pump before interrupting an [Aid Society](../codex/factions.md#aid-society) meeting. Later, she went missing after [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) locked her inside Mr. Pettifer's toolhouse, though she was eventually found. After [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returned to teaching, Lucy was terrified by stories of family ghosts told by a classmate. She and her brother were ultimately able to remain permanently at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) after a trust fund was left for them following Richard Farrow's death. During a severe hailstorm, Lucy sheltered at home with her family, and she later welcomed [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) back when she returned home for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holiday. However, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) later forced Lucy to skip Sunday School as part of his rebellious behavior.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P47](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0047), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), +26 more_

## Relationships

### [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lucy--robin-farrow.md)

Lucy and [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) are twin siblings brought to live at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) following their mother's death. Robin's energetic prank-playing often targets Lucy, such as enticing her outside until she gets drenched, tricking her into jumping into a pigpen, and locking her in Mr. Pettifer's toolhouse.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), +20 more_

- Sibling of — brother and sister  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), +9 more</sub>

### [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lucy--thirza-abernethy.md)

[Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) is a relative who took in Lucy and her twin brother after they were orphaned, bringing them to live at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) to raise them. She actively manages the household and oversees the children, helping lead the search when Lucy goes missing after a prank.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), +6 more_

- Relative of — raised her upon mother's death  <sub>[v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P11](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0011)</sub>

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lucy--nell-harcourt.md)

[Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) resides at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) alongside Lucy, welcoming her and her twin brother to the home. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) actively participates in searching for Lucy when she disappears and works with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) to manage Robin's pranks that affect Lucy.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), +9 more_

- Friend of — welcomed her home warmly with Robin (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Again P14](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0014)</sub>
